jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager - Investigator Initiated Studies
jobs.location_raw: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; New York; New Jersey; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania; Atlanta, GA; Washington, DC; Orlando, Florida; Fairfax, VA; Boston, MA
jobs.description_text: The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) - Investigator Initiated Studies is responsible for the oversight and management of all clinical operational activities for investigator initiated studies. The CTM will interact well with the HeartFlow Clinical Research staff and collaborate effectively with HeartFlow onsite and field staff, clinical research coordinators, principal investigators, and vendors to aid in ensuring clinical studies meet or exceed timelines and maintain high quality standards. The CTM will have demonstrated experience with clinical research study execution, exceptional organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and will be comfortable working in a fast-paced start-up culture. Job Responsibilities : Participates in clinical research activities including management of clinical study sites, management of study documentation, vendor management, and completion of project management tasks. Develops clinical trial timelines, enrollment projections, and instructional materials in support of trial execution, including project, communication, monitoring, recruitment, risk mitigation, and contingency plans. Participates in and leads process improvement activities within the department and cross functionally, including SOP development. Conducts study start-up activities including leading study kick off meetings, contract management, and site onboarding and training. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.location_raw: Rohnert Park, CA; San Francisco Bay Area, CA
jobs.description_text: The Data Analyst builds and maintains the business-facing layer of HeartFlow’s data platform — analytical applications, the reporting and visualization architecture, and the semantic model definitions that serve them. This is a hands-on technical role combining application development with business intelligence architecture: work product includes code that is version controlled, peer reviewed, and deployed through continuous integration, as well as the dashboards, reports, and interfaces through which the business consumes it. The role builds on data warehoused in Amazon Redshift, contributing to the semantic model, the reporting and visualization architecture, analytical applications, and the data quality validation and access governance around them. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, Compliance, Customer Success, and Medical Education, translating business questions into engineered, reusable data products rather than one-off deliverables. The role spans both engineering and business fluency. The same person who writes the application code is expected to sit with the stakeholder who will use it, understand the decision it supports, and stay with it through adoption and iteration. Work ranges from a governed dashboard consumed by sales leadership to a purpose-built application that replaces a manual process outright. jobs.description_text: This role will lead a team to deliver world-class support to Heartflow’s customers, including physicians and hospital staff using our revolutionary SaaS technology to manage their patients. This person will lead overall customer support processes, including resolution of customer issues and all investigations of customer complaints regarding HeartFlow’s product quality and accuracy. This role will be central to coordinating cross-functional efforts needed to support Heartflow’s customers, including investigating issues, summarizing customer feedback and data, and representing customer needs and priorities to other departments in the company. This person has a primary responsibility to ensure an outstanding end-to-end customer experience with Heartflow. Job Responsibilities : Lead a team of customer support specialists to ensure Heartflow’s customers have excellent experience with our SaaS non-invasive medical technology. Grow talent within the support team. Identify needed skills, upskill team members, coach and mentor individuals for success. Define strategies to scale customer support efficiently with commercial growth. Develop and maintain training, tools, and processes to improve customer satisfaction and first contact resolution or efficient escalation. jobs.title: Manager, Leadership Development & Sales Training
jobs.description_text: Are you passionate about developing sales leaders and building the content that helps them succeed? The Manager, Leadership Development & Sales Training will lead the design and facilitation of a new leadership development track for Heartflow's sales organization, with primary emphasis on original content creation and hands-on leadership coaching. In the near term, this role will also support new hire onboarding, transitioning over time to a primary focus on leadership development as that track is built out. In this highly visible and hands-on position, you will build net-new training content, facilitate leadership development sessions in person and virtually, and work directly with new leaders on their own development. Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales and Commercial partners to ensure that training content and delivery reflect real-world needs and business goals. This is a remote position, with up to 25% travel throughout the U.S. required. jobs.title: Principal Device Quality Engineer
jobs.location_raw: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity As the Principal Device Quality Engineer , you will serve as the global subject matter expert (SME) for software quality and design excellence. You will bridge the gap between rapid Agile development and rigorous medical device regulations, ensuring that our digital health solutions—including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and AI/ML-enabled technologies—are safe, secure, and compliant. Your core responsibility will be overseeing compliance around the end to end design control process within the Heartflow’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), advising on everything from initial architecture and security-by-design to global regulatory submissions and post-market surveillance. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership SME Guidance: Act as the primary authority on global regulatory standards, including IEC 62304, IEC 82304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, and AAMI TIR45 . Modern SDLC Evolution: Lead the integration of modern technologies into the Quality Management System (QMS), specifically defining validation frameworks for AI/ML, Cloud Infrastructure (SaaS), and Cybersecurity (ISO 81001-5-1) . Agile Transformation: Partner with engineering teams to implement "Compliance at Speed," applying Agile best practices while maintaining total regulatory rigor. Commit to execution to ensure predictable, complete, high quality releases. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Quality System & Compliance
jobs.location_raw: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States
jobs.description_text: As the Senior Manager of Quality System and Quality (Regulatory) Compliance , you are a pivotal leader responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System (QMS), oversight, and associated tools. You will lead our efforts to ensure robust compliance with national and international medical device regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP. This role is a unique blend of strategic foresight and tactical leadership, requiring a deep expertise in QMS setup and management, particularly for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with ability to make thoughtful changes and enhance the overall QMS. You will lead a high-performing team of quality professionals , championing a "Quality-first" culture and driving data-driven decisions. Your proven track record of navigating complex regulatory landscapes, including FDA, PMDA, IEC, EU MDR, and ISO regulations and standards , is essential to our success. Job Responsibilities : Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight Manage holistic aspects of the QMS to ensure compliance with global regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP countries’ requirements. Oversee the following key QMS subsystems: CAPA subsystem, Document Control, Training, Management Review, Internal Audits, and External Audit management, QMS Tool Validation, and Supplier Management. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines. ABOUT THE JOB We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As Deputy Chief Engineer in Discovery, you lead the technical work on concepts nobody has proven, usually several at once. You learn whatever domain each one lives in and build the thing that tests it: the prototype, the test article, the demonstration. Analysis gets a concept to the point where it is worth building; building it is how we find out. You are the technical authority for the concepts you own: you set the approach, review the work, and decide, on the evidence, which concepts continue and which stop. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, build it, test it, and reach a solution. You are not hired for a particular skill set. jobs.description_text: WHAT YOU'LL DO Full cycle PCB design including collecting requirements, schematic design, component selection, supervision or completion of layout, bring-up, test, debug and integration with the system. Development of fuzing circuitry for missile systems. Closely collaborate with vehicle development teams to design, document, and produce tailored fuzing systems and effectors. Develop system interconnect diagrams and define wire harnesses that connect electronic equipment within the vehicle. Provide support and collaborate within other air vehicle subsystem development constraints. Vendor surveys and evaluation to support sourcing for system components. Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews. Build up and test system components through lab, ground, and flight tests. Low level firmware development for bring-up and test. Root cause analysis in support of field operations. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS BS or higher degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex board designs. Competence with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, thermal chambers, current-probes, and automation of tests. Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc. Familiarity with common MCU, CPU, FPGA devices and technologies.
